title: Signal: Possible a Nexus password passed with --nexus-password in source
scope: One line, matching a Nexus password passed with --nexus-password.
limitations: Shape-only: a specific tool flag followed by a password- or token-shaped literal. It cannot prove the value is live, and it does not see credentials assembled at run time from several variables.
fpNotes: Documentation pages that show the flag with a placeholder value, and wrapper scripts that pass an environment-variable reference, are the common false positives; the pattern requires a shaped literal and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
